note: USFS (Helena-Lewis & Clark NF, Rocky Mountain RD) campground 31 mi W of Augusta on gravel FR 235, on the South Fork Sun River at a Bob Marshall Wilderness trailhead. General campground with horse/hiker trail access (not equestrian-only). Mandatory food storage (bears). --Claude
summary: Forest Service page (updated Apr 29, 2026): confirmed 7 sites, vault toilets, no water, $10 (+$5 extra vehicle); added season note 'availability depends on road access'. Not stated: trailer length (derived 35 left), reservations/FCFS (derived left), stay limit. Alerts: prescribed fire notice, NCDE food storage, regional camping restrictions, Park Lake closure (elsewhere); none for South Fork or FR 235. Note trimmed of restated values.
